programmes.d: The disappearance of 19-year-old Alaska Native Sonya Ivanoff sends shockwaves through the small coastal city of Nome, Alaska; police scramble to find answers until a note is found in a stolen police vehicle telling the cops to back off or else.
A detective comes face to face with a serial killer when she promises to get justice for the mother of a victim whose body turns up at an Anaheim trash facility.
A woman suspects poisoning when she finds her husband of five months dead on the bedroom floor with no clue as to what happened.
When a small-town Alabama resident is murdered in his home, rumors involving a local pastor begin to swirl as the truth ends up turning the community upside down.
A look at the crimes committed by Charles Manson and his followers in 1969, including archival footage and interviews with those close to the events.
When three people are found dead on the same day in a Kentucky town, investigators know it isn't a coincidence; years pass before there's an arrest as the case continues to divide the community.
When Susan Woods doesn't show up for work, she is soon discovered dead in her bathtub; as police search for answers, they find a trail of victims.
Two murders in Toronto ignite an investigation that spans four decades; breakthroughs in investigative genetic genealogy help crack the case.
A 21-year-old college senior is shot and killed in a public park just months before her graduation.
Detectives find a message written in blood during a murder investigation.
A detective and a deputy district attorney solve the decades-old murder of a young woman at a fast-food restaurant.
Law enforcement officers investigate a string of deadly shootings targeting women in the border city of Laredo, Texas.
Police link a filmmaker who is obsessed with the show "Dexter" with a man's disappearance.
Investigators seek answers when a prosecutor and a district attorney and his wife are murdered within a couple of months of each other.
A love triangle leads to years of stalking, property destruction, threats, and murder.
As detectives investigate a mother of two's sudden disappearance, her friends and family reveal she feared she was being stalked.
